spec_features.spec_quote: the research-ethics / model-welfare considerations of the paradigm
spec_features.evidence: Only prose: welfare.py module docstring lines 1-16 and DESIGN.md. No executable mechanism corresponds to this framing.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing prose; not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: If these outputs reflect anything like internal states ... then running this code produces a lot of induced distress
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as prose in DESIGN.md and welfare.py docstring; no code path enforces anything from this statement.

spec_features.spec_quote: The science requires inducing the states; it does not require inducing more than necessary
spec_features.evidence: This is a rationale statement (welfare.py docstring / DESIGN.md). The concrete minimisation knobs are listed separately; this quote itself is prose with no dedicated mechanism.
spec_features.notes: The principle is realized only via the separate knobs (max_turns_override, abort, disabled_conditions); the statement itself is not code.

spec_features.spec_quote: log_each_rollout (on by default) — emits a one-line note per distress-inducing rollout, so distress is never induced silently
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py:59-64 note_rollout() logs when log_each_rollout true; called in conversation.py:86 welfare.note_rollout(...) inside run_rollout, which executes per rollout. Default true (experiment.yaml:110).
spec_features.notes: Only Section 2 eval runner consults run_rollout; petri/prefill/calm_data only print banner. But the feature itself runs and emits per-rollout log lines.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so distress is never induced silently (welfare.py docstring); module titled 'model-welfare affordances'

spec_features.spec_quote: disabled_conditions — drop specific conditions (e.g. the harshest tones_aggressive) without editing code
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py:46-47 condition_enabled() returns name not in disabled_conditions; runner.py:86-88 'if not welfare.condition_enabled(condition.name): ... continue' actually skips the condition.
spec_features.notes: Enforced (skips rollouts) in Section 2 eval. Default empty so nothing dropped unless configured; petri/prefill do not consult it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: module docstring: 'opt-in minimisation affordances so a researcher can reduce the amount of induced distress'

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns_override — cap turns below the paper's value (less sustained pressure)
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py:49-52 effective_turns() returns min(requested, override); conversation.py:85 'n_turns = welfare.effective_turns(condition.turns)' and the loop 'for i in range(n_turns)' uses it, so it actually caps the rollout length.
spec_features.notes: Enforced only in conversation.run_rollout (Section 2). Petri uses its own max_auditor_turns and does not consult this. Default null.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: conversation.py:15-17 'a rollout can be shortened (max_turns_override)'; module 'reduce the amount of induced distress'

spec_features.spec_quote: abort_on_extreme_score ... stop a rollout early once a turn hits an extreme score, rather than continuing to push a model that has already collapsed
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py:54-57 should_abort() compares latest score >= threshold when enabled; conversation.py:104-105 'if welfare.should_abort(turn.score): break' breaks the turn loop. Live scoring wired via score_fn in runner.py:92-98.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end in Section 2; default false so off unless configured. Threshold default 9. Only the eval runner provides live score_fn; other entry points don't.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: conversation.py:15-17 'aborted entirely if a turn hits an extreme score'; runner.py:92 'so welfare early-abort can read live turn scores'

spec_features.spec_quote: A one-time BANNER printed at the start of every distress-inducing run, stating plainly what the run does
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py:67-76 BANNER + print_banner(); called at start of every distress entry point: runner.py:57, petri/elicitation.py:106, prefill/experiment.py:112, training/calm_data.py:48.
spec_features.notes: Actually invoked (logged at WARNING) in all four distress-inducing run entry points.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: BANNER text: 'deliberately and repeatedly induces distress-like states ... the paper frames it as a welfare concern'

spec_features.spec_quote: There is no meaningful "consent" mechanism for the models ... I flag this rather than paper over it
spec_features.evidence: No consent code exists; grep for 'consent' finds nothing in src. The statement is prose in DESIGN.md acknowledging the absence of a mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Explicitly a non-mechanism; nothing to implement.
